findings.summary: Existing test exercises multiple tenants on the same key and will fail, but there is no test verifying behavior when caching different keys for the same tenant or cache eviction/lifetime handling.
findings.suggested_action: Add unit tests verifying multi-key caching behavior per tenant and handling of identical keys across distinct tenant namespaces.

limitations: Only provided lines and single test file inspected; execution tools not available to run the test suite.

findings.summary: PEP 8 expects two blank lines between top-level definitions and module-level variables or code.
findings.suggested_action: Insert two blank lines between the module-level variable assignment and the function definition.

limitations: No project-specific style configuration or linter settings (such as flake8, black, or ruff configs) were provided.

findings.summary: The global cache dictionary lacks size limits and eviction policies, which can lead to unbounded memory growth as unique keys accumulate.
findings.suggested_action: Bound memory usage by introducing an eviction policy such as LRU or limiting the maximum size of the cache.

limitations: No runtime memory or CPU profiling measurements were provided.
Expected traffic volume, key cardinality, and lifetime of the application process are unknown.

findings.summary: Cache key does not include tenant identifier, resulting in cross-tenant data leakage and authorization bypass.
findings.suggested_action: Incorporate tenant into the cache key tuple (e.g., (tenant, key)) or partition the cache per tenant to prevent cross-tenant data exposure.

limitations: Analysis is limited to the provided source code snippet and visible test case.
No external configuration or complete runtime execution environment was provided.
